newsitem.title: USA: Amtech launches search for president/COO.
newsitem.headline: Amtech launches search for president/COO.

text.p: Amtech Corp said Wednesday its board of directors approved a national search for a new president and chief operating officer who, when hired, will assume the president's title, held since 1987 by G. Russell Mortenson, who would retain the position of chief executive officer.
The company said that the board has elected Mortenson, currently its president and chief executive officer, to the added position of chairman of the board.
In addition, the company named John Wilson as president and chief operating officer of its TSG unit and Douglas Davis as president and chief operating officer of its IDG unit.
Wilson previously served as senior vice president of marketing and sales for TSG, and Davis was vice president of IDG.
Amtech Corporation is a provider of wireless data and security technologies to serve the intelligent transportation, electronic security, logistics, and other markets.
